Yeah, definitely more units!|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 28 ([[Challenge Trials]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Tanker''' is a support enemy that appears in [[Molten Mode|Molten]] mode, [[Challenge Trials]] and [[Badlands II]]. It also appears in [[The Takeover Event]]. It functions similarly to the [[Boomer]], though in comparison it has higher health, slower speed and increased debuffs. It has two abilities, all of which happen upon losing certain amounts of health. Upon losing 67% of its health, it will release gas that heals enemies in a radius of 12. While this is meant to heal them by 1 every 0.5 tick for 15 seconds, this due to bugs only happens once, meaning this ability in total heals 1 health for each enemy near it. The '''Tanker''' cannot heal itself but can heal other '''Tankers'''. Its second ability happens upon death, where it will apply a 70% [[Fatigue Debuff]] and a 20% [[Range Debuff]] to all towers in a radius of 12, which lasts 10 seconds. ==Appearance== The '''Tanker''' has light green skin. It wears red pants with a black belt and brown bandages around its mutated arms. It also has grey hair. As its name suggests, it has multiple tanks on its body, some at the front of its torso and others at the back, held together with chains. Its arms also have multiple tubes going through them. On its head, it also wears a brown gas mask with neon red lens. ==Strategy== *Killing the '''Tanker''' before it gets within range of your towers is the most ideal way to deal with '''Tanker'''. Keep in mind that it has quite a long debuff time. **Placing your towers away from the path is a good way to avoid the '''Tanker's''' debuff. **Long-range towers, such as the [[Hunter]], [[Ranger]] or [[Turret]] are the best at keeping a distance away from the '''Tanker'''. **The [[Engineer]]'s sentries can also be useful, as the sentries cannot be debuffed. *The [[DJ Booth]] allows towers to shoot the '''Tanker''' from further away, potentially defeating it before it blows up near your towers. **It and the [[Commander]] can also partially negate the '''Tanker's''' debuffs. *While the [[Medic]] is not able to shield towers from the [[Fatigue Debuff]] or [[Range Debuff]], the shield on towers is not broken by them, meaning its [[Firerate Buff]] can be used to partially mitigate the '''Tanker's''' debuffs. **Towers which are normally immune to stuns by default are not immune to the debuffs either. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} TankerWalkAnimation.gif|Walk animation (11 December 2024 – Present) TankerDeathAnimation.gif|Death animation (11 December 2024 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1Tanker.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseTanker.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} V2.2.0GenericThumbnail11.png|'''Tanker''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} TankerDG.gif|'''Tanker''' on a development video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} IndexTanker.png|'''Tanker''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Update History== *'''11 December 2024''' -
